records.source: Expected object diameter in pixels. Plaque Assay starts at 0, which uses the model's own scale; positive values are measured in original input-image pixels and adjusted when wells are resized. Legacy mask-finetune and check_cellpose_models pass it to model.eval(diameter=...). Prefer per-object diameter settings in other modules. Default 30 for mask-finetune; check_cellpose_models starts at 40.
records.translation: 预期的对象直径，单位为像素。Plaque Assay 的初始值为 0，表示使用模型自身的尺度；正值以原始输入图像的像素为单位，并会在调整孔图像大小时相应换算。旧版 mask-finetune 和 check_cellpose_models 工具将该值传递给 model.eval(diameter=...)。在其他模块中，请优先使用各对象类型各自的直径设置。mask-finetune 的默认值为 30；check_cellpose_models 的初始值为 40。
